LESSON: PROPHET (S.A.W.)’S JOURNEY TO TAIF

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.3: Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif
2. Practise Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif in the examples.
2. Explain Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif
2. Practise Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Prophet (S.A.W.)’s Journey to Taif

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
